test_objective: Check that you can update a context source registration by id

test_cases.name: 034_01_01 Update a context source registration by id
test_cases.doc: Check that you can update a context source registration by id
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response containing:
        Check Retrieving Context Source Registration and
    Query Parameter: registration_id set to 'registration_id=${registration_id}' and
    Query Parameter: context set to 'https://forge.etsi.org/rep/cim/ngsi-ld-test-suite/-/raw/develop/resources/jsonld-contexts/ngsi-ld-test-suite-compound.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to 'accept=${CONTENT_TYPE_LD_JSON}' and
    Query Parameter: registration_payload set to 'registration_payload=${registration_payload}' and
        Response Status Code set to 204
}
